_grindOverShortLeg: Off: a plan never grinds while a quest anywhere pays (the player: grinding is up to the player - give them quests all the way through). On: a zone with fewer than minTurnins hand-ins is only worth the trip when it beats grinding the level.
_grind: Where the quests run out at your level (Horde 26-28, Alliance around 33: the next zones' quests need a level or two more), grind a level on mobs that fit instead of stopping or hopping zones for one hand-in; the step says a dungeon run does it too. Dungeons are never routed in.
_xpRuns: Dungeon runs for their XP alone (no quests of yours inside): off - a dungeon takes a group and an hour or two; set true to have the planner consider them.
_dungeonMinutes: A full run with a levelled group, by dungeon area id (QuestieDB support/Forever/Zones/dungeons.lua) - for XP runs and dungeon legs; dungeonRunMin (50) for any other.
_dungeonsInPath: Dungeon runs inside your path: off - a dungeon needs a group, which can be hard to find, so it is never a step you're routed into. Each dungeon worth doing is offered as a side trip instead (the Side trips window). true: the planner may put a run with your quests inside into a leg.
